old_gate.criteria: K=6; per-word >=1 unique discriminating facet; max facet-Jaccard <= 0.34; mean <= 0.20; no best-effort set; caps not relaxed
old_gate.why_failed: facet render map covered ONLY 11 varṇas; 21/37 candidates invalid; no size-6 subset had per-word unique facet (ra alone in 9/16 valid words)
old_gate.preserved: K, Jaccard caps, per-word-uniqueness, no-cap-relaxation, exhaustive-pool enumeration, facet↔varṇa bijection (Jaccard on consonant sets == facet-Jaccard)
old_gate.revised: substrate = native Devanāgarī consonant backbone (33 confirmatory units, not 11 rendered); added strengthened controls C5/C6 length-non-identifying, C8 same-valence, C10 rare-only flag

cross_word_mismatch_arm.note: pair each word with another member's packet

scrambled_packet_arm.note: reassign packets across words / permute feature order

random_varna_assignment_arm.note: structure-preserving permutation of the 33 consonant→pole assignment

packet_length_matched_controls.note: requires >=2 words per length in the set (criterion C5/C6)

same_valence_comparisons.note: requires >=1 same-valence pair; valence is a balance label, not fit

no_per_word_polarity_selection.note: both poles fixed per word by construction

blind_word_identity_matching.note: forced-choice match packet→word among the set

no_open_ended_plausibility_endpoint.note: endpoint is forced-choice accuracy, not 'sounds plausible?'

guardrails: Consonant backbone only; no vowel/marker pole in packets; no semantic fit in selection; no judges/scoring/prereg. B1.10 pole-legibility negative and the qualitative guarded prior preserved.
